Agent-assisted editing - external producer, same mutation boundary
|
|-- Page-owned PromptComposerCoordinator
|   |-- Entries, drafts, captured requests and polling timers
|   |-- submit() -> client.capture(): pinned canvas version + base revision
|   |-- client.start() / status() / cancel(); retry retains the exact request
|   `-- Lifetime independent of selection, panel visibility and undo
|
|-- DiagramEditService (application service, not owned by the composer)
|   |-- Runs + request-ID deduplication
|   |-- Captured canvas + pinned references + AgentContext -> diagram generation
|   `-- DiagramEditCanvasPort: command transport to the live canvas
|       |-- apply(): edits use captured version + baseRevisionId
|       `-- create(): read latest version for placement; retry version conflicts
|
`-- Page-owned live command endpoint
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge
    |   |-- Register ephemeral canvas; poll commands -> page handler -> replies
    |   `-- Cleanup aborts polling and unregisters the canvas instance
    `-- DiagramRevisionReceiver
        |-- apply()/batch() -> controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
        |   `-- Revision edits also check expected base revision
        |-- Retain receipt before persistence: retry must not edit twice
        `-- Page callback: persistence.sync([id]) + storage.flush()
            |-- Acknowledge only after persistence completes
            `-- Failed flush -> PERSISTENCE_PENDING; retry same request
